Maya (product): Quick sync — customer asks for a machine-readable way to understand "what a model supports" (tools, streaming, JSON output, token caps). Need a discovery endpoint + capability flags. Goals: 1) make client routing decisions, 2) enable conservative fallbacks when model lacks features, 3) power SDK/console UI.

Kai (eng-runtime): Thanks — important constraints: runtime can't return per-request full capability proofs. We can surface an advertised manifest per model-version. Must limit array sizes (no huge tool lists) and include token limits. Streaming vs non-streaming: runtime supports both but streaming adds latency guarantees.

Pranav (eng-ml): Proposal for minimal response shape:
```
{
  "model": "redwood-rlhf-2",
  "version": "2026-02-15",
  "capabilities": ["generation","chat","embeddings"],
  "tools": [{"name":"browser","sync":false}],
  "streaming": true,
  "max_input_tokens": 8192,
  "max_output_tokens": 2048
}
```
We should include a machine-readable enum for structured outputs (e.g., json_schema, jsonl) and a short "confidence" string for claims (e.g., "verified", "advertised", "experimental").

Leah (devex): SDK impact: clients will want typed flags. Recommend a stable shape with optional fields. Also surface human-readable descriptions for each capability for console UX. Keep field names snake_case for consistency with current API.

Tamsin (solutions): Enterprise asks: include policy tags (pii, regulated), KMS support note, and whether tool outputs leave the sandbox. Also need a rollout gate: only advertised when model vetted for that tenant (dedicated/private). Customers will want to opt into experimental flags.

Maya (product): Launch criteria suggestion:
- Manifest exists for each model version in catalog
- 3 internal integrations exercise discovery (console, SDK, routing)
- Documentation + PTG (product test group) with 10 customer prompts
- Metrics: <1% client breakages during canary; no silent feature regressions

Kai (eng-runtime): Implementation notes: store manifests in model metadata service; cache at edge with TTL; prefer delta updates. For streaming=true, include stream_slo_ms as a hint. We should cap tools array to 50 entries, and set max combined token budget field.

Pranav (eng-ml): Also: define "capability provenance" — how we mark a capability as verified. Maybe fields: claims_source: ["model-card","benchmarks","manual-test"]. Keep schema extensible.

capability-bot: sample discovery payload generated for redwood-rlhf-2 (sanitized) available at /models/redwood-rlhf-2/manifest.json

Leah (devex): Action items:
- Pranav: draft schema + enum list by EOD Friday
- Kai: storage/caching/limits doc + ops cost estimate by next Tue
- Maya: customer acceptance criteria + PTG plan
- Tamsin: enterprise checkbox matrix for experimental flags

Maya (product): Agreement? If no objections, we'll make the manifest MVP minimal: model, version, capabilities[], streaming(bool), max_input_tokens, max_output_tokens, tools[] (name, sync), claims_source, policy_tags[]. Rollout: internal canary -> beta customers -> general availability.

Kai (eng-runtime): +1 — one note: keep token fields conservative; runtime enforces hard limits independently.

Pranav (eng-ml): +1 — will include 'confidence' and 'claims_source' in schema.

Tamsin (solutions): +1 from me.

Leah (devex): +1 — will prepare SDK mapping.

Maya (product): Great, I'll create a GH issue and link to this thread. :rocket:
